findings.claim: L18 is a single very long dense paragraph that packs RED, GREEN, byte-identical proof, message change, models.md change, an assumption note and two OPEN items into one bullet. The two OPEN items needing owner or follow-up action (the seedRoleSources fix and the stale .approval.json approval) are buried at the end, which makes them easy to miss when scanning the Log.

L18 cites commit `dbae346c` as the T19 work, while this docs commit is a different one. The entry gives no way to tell from the log that the evidence refers to a prior commit, and the claim that `go test ./agentgen/...` is ok sits beside two named failing tests in engine/cmd, so a reader could take 'GREEN' as covering the whole suite. The scope of the GREEN claim (agentgen package only) is not stated against the known failures.

evidence: The diff only appends one Log entry (L18) to odd/tasks/labdrian-orchestrator-opencode.md; no code or specs are changed.
The entry is internally consistent with its stated partial status: T19 is declared unticked and the two blocking items are named with their causes and remedies.
Only readability concerns found; I could not verify the claims about dbae346c or test outcomes since only the diff is visible.
